articles.company_name: Canada Goose Holdings Inc. Subordinate Voting Shares
articles.summary: Canada Goose Holdings Inc. (NYSE, TSX: GOOS) today announced that it will participate in the Goldman Sachs 33 rd Annual Global Consumer Retail Conference being held on September 14, 2026. Neil Bowden, Chief Financial Officer will participate in a fireside chat at 9:15 am ET, as well as in one-on-one meetings. The fireside chat will be webcast live on our investor relations website, http://investor.canadagoose.com . An archived webcast will be available after the conclusion of the presentation. About Canada Goose Canada Goose is dedicated to empowering discovery and pushing boundaries in design, functionality, and style. Inspired by our Canadian heritage, we craft high-performance outerwear, apparel, footwear, and accessories that elevate craftsmanship and embrace individuality. Rooted in resilience and driven by a pioneering spirit, we embolden explorers to thrive in all environments while preserving the planet they roam. For more information, visit www.canadagoose.com .
articles.title: Canada Goose Announces Participation in Goldman Sachs 33rd Annual Global Consumer & Retail Conference
